segments.text: Constitutional Law studies the rules that create, distribute and limit public power. FPSC combines general constitutional concepts, comparative constitutional systems, Pakistan’s constitutional history and important Pakistani cases.

items.text: Prepare concepts first; they become the vocabulary for every comparative answer.
executive, legislature, judiciary, constitution type, federal/unitary character and review.
Prepare Pakistan history as a timeline.
For cases, learn facts in one line, legal issue, holding and constitutional significance.

segments.text: First master the vocabulary of rule of law, separation of powers, judicial review and rights. Next compare constitutional systems through one common template. Finally study Pakistan as a timeline and connect the leading cases to each constitutional crisis or institutional question.
